rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for high reputation or prestige.

example.english: This old shop has always had a lot of prestige among local residents.
example.traditional: 呢間老字號喺街坊入面一直都好有聲望。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 lou5 zi6 hou6 hai2 gaai1 fong1 jap6 min6 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 jau5 sing1 mong6

rows.note: Use this when prestige is tied to authority and the respect a person or institution commands.

example.english: After serving as a principal for decades, they have a lot of prestige in education.
example.traditional: 佢做咗幾十年校長，喺教育界好有威望。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4 haau6 zoeng2 hai2 gaau3 juk6 gaai3 hou2 jau5 wai1 mong6
